title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Trello is seeking a Senior Data Scientist who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our data capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute data initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 3+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Statistics, Problem Solving, Team Management, Machine Learning
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: MYR 200,000 – MYR 300,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

We are looking for a talented Director of Account Executive to join our dynamic team at Disney. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining finance solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 4 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Risk Management, GAAP, Stakeholder Management, Forecasting
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of MYR 55,000 – MYR 90,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Lead Financial Analyst
description:

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

- 7 years of experience in a similar role

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of MYR 200,000 – MYR 300,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

CrowdStrike is seeking a Director of Electrical Engineer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Director of Electrical Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 1+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in JavaScript, Kubernetes, GraphQL, Leadership
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: MYR 140,000 – MYR 200,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

TTEC is seeking a Junior Technical Writer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Junior Technical Writer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our general capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute general initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 6+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Communication, Stakeholder Management, Analytical Thinking, Problem Solving
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: MYR 55,000 – MYR 90,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
Join Salesforce as a Senior Recruiter and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Senior Recruiter with strong expertise in design. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute design projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 4 years of experience as a Senior Recruiter or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Sketch, Adobe XD, User Research, UI/UX
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: MYR 90,000 – MYR 140,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

title: Associate Biomedical Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented Associate Biomedical Engineer to join our dynamic team at anthem. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**

- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

- Competitive salary of MYR 30,000 – MYR 55,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- Hybrid work options available
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment
